title: QuickBooks still receives the invoice prices by line category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging with the QuickBooks sandbox connected (the QA site too only if QuickBooks is connected there); production is not needed.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35, mapped to a QuickBooks item for this test, item A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1) and a part in category A priced $135.00, invoiced.
  • Sign in to the QuickBooks sandbox in a second browser window.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps: 1. Open work order 1's invoice in the QuickBooks sandbox once it has synced.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The QuickBooks line reads $135.00 ($100.00 × 1.35).
  • It uses item A, category A's item.
